D: Two people who can't stand each other pretend to be a couple at a destination wedding in Sydney.
P: Serve the snacks when the wedding party heads out on the harbour.
S: the wedding party out on Sydney Harbour
Cooked king prawns piled on ice with lemon wedges and a seafood sauce of mayo, tomato sauce and a dash of hot sauce.
the wedding party taking in Sydney
Mini beef pies of mince and gravy in shortcrust with puff lids, baked at 200C for 20 minutes, with tomato sauce.
the view of the Opera House
Oysters on crushed ice with a dressing of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, and lemon wedges.
M: Lamb cutlets grilled with rosemary and garlic, with a potato salad and a big green salad.
the destination wedding by the water
Barramundi fillets pan-fried skin side down until crisp, with lemon butter and capers, and crushed potatoes.
W: Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream, passionfruit, kiwifruit and strawberries.
K: Sparkling wine or sparkling apple juice with a strawberry in each glass.

s.note: the wedding party out on Sydney Harbour
s.how: Pile crushed ice onto a platter and arrange 500g cooked prawns on top with lemon wedges. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise with 2 tbsp tomato sauce and a dash of hot sauce. Serve in a bowl beside the prawns for a Sydney Harbour wedding.

s.note: the wedding party taking in Sydney
s.how: Brown 500g beef mince with a diced onion, add 250ml beef stock and simmer until thick, then cool. Line a muffin tin with shortcrust rounds, fill and top with puff lids. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes and serve with tomato sauce.

m.note: the destination wedding by the water
m.how: Boil 800g baby potatoes and crush lightly. Pan-fry 4 barramundi fillets skin side down until crisp, then flip for a minute. Add butter, lemon juice and capers to the pan and spoon over the fish. Serve with the potatoes.

w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, passionfruit, kiwifruit and strawberries.

d.how: Chill sparkling wine and sparkling apple juice for an hour. Drop a halved strawberry into each flute and pour the wine for the grown-ups and apple juice for the rest. Toast with the harbour in the background.
